$comment: Provenance for every substantive claim rendered on the /lp BDC Promotions landing page. Each record ties on-page copy to an authoritative source: the customer's live site, the in-repo build spec/plan, or the paid-LP build task brief. No proof (metrics, named results, testimonials-as-fact) is invented here; records that describe a 'proof standard' document what evidence BDC offers, not specific outcomes.

live-site.description: The customer's live BDC Promotions website. Canonical origin recorded in the build plan; its substantive copy is preserved per the plan's global constraints.

design-spec.description: Approved BDC Promotions build design spec (visual direction, page structure, phone-first path).

build-plan.description: Approved BDC Promotions implementation plan; states preserved business facts including the phone number.

lp-task.description: Paid landing-page build task brief for /lp. Origin of LP-specific elements: the free-audit offer framing, the inventory qualifier, the automotive service set, the proof standard, and the tracking IDs.

ai-generated-visual.description: AI-generated, human-approved supporting visuals added to give the /lp page an editorial visual rhythm. They are illustrative depictions of BDC Promotions' work — NOT customer proof. They carry no metrics, named results, or testimonials, and make no factual claim beyond the generic activity depicted.

records.claim: Turn paid social into more qualified showroom appointments — BDC Promotions turns paid social attention into booked appointments and showroom opportunities, not impressions that never reach the sales floor.
records.note: Preserves the live site's appointment-focused hero message (design spec §Page Structure item 2). No specific numbers are claimed.

records.claim: 15 years spent exclusively on automotive marketing for dealerships.
records.note: Existing customer brand claim carried over from the live BDC Promotions site; preserved per build-plan global constraint 'preserve the current site's substantive copy'. Not independently re-verified here — it is the customer's own stated tenure.

records.claim: Four dealership value pillars: Fast, Focused, Social, Results.
records.note: Design spec §Page Structure item 3: 'Four dealership value points: fast response, automotive focus, social engagement, and results.'

records.claim: Automotive marketing services: New-car lead generation, Inventory ads, Event ads, Reels & value-proposition videos, Testimonial videos.
records.note: LP-specific automotive service set specified by the paid-LP task brief; consistent with the website spec's core services (design spec item 4: Messenger lead response, paid social campaigns, appointment generation). Descriptive of offerings, not claimed results.

records.claim: Proof standard: verified campaign screenshots pulled from the ad platforms, real named-dealership testimonials, and outcomes measured against the dealership's own CRM.
records.note: Describes the TYPE of evidence BDC provides during an audit — a proof standard, not any specific metric or named result. No figures or client names are asserted as fact in the copy.

records.claim: Free dealership marketing audit and consultation, no obligation: (1) Review your current marketing, (2) Identify the biggest conversion gaps, (3) Deliver focused next-step recommendations.
records.note: Free-audit offer and three-step process defined by the paid-LP task brief.

records.claim: Inventory qualifier question 'How many vehicles do you currently have in your inventory?' with exactly two options: 'Fewer than 50' and '50 or more' (50 or more is the qualifying answer).
records.note: Exact qualifier question and option labels specified by the paid-LP task brief. Answer is captured as metadata and never suppresses lead delivery.
Build plan global constraint records the phone number '352-207-1074'; design spec uses tel:3522071074. Existing customer business number.

records.claim: FAQ: 'We partner with dealerships across multiple U.S. states. Share your details on the form or give us a call and we'll confirm fit for your market.'
records.note: Deliberately non-specific coverage statement from the LP task brief; no specific state list or exclusivity is asserted, and fit is confirmed per prospect rather than claimed.

records.claim: Three supporting section visuals: inventory-ad production (Services), a BDC specialist following up with a shopper (Proof Standard), and an audit consultation walkthrough (How The Free Audit Works).
records.note: AI-generated, human-approved illustrative visuals — supporting art, not customer proof. Each is used exactly once with distinct alt text; the surrounding copy asserts no metrics, testimonials, or specific results tied to these images. Depict generic BDC Promotions activity only.
